items.title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
items.description: It marks the second attack on the country in three days and comes as the US and Iran remain locked in a stand-off over the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Three men sentenced to death in Jordan over fatal church mass shooting
items.description: The attack on funeral at a Greek Orthodox church killed nine and injured 34 others last month.

items.title: South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating
items.description: Han Won-seok, 34, confessed to using a hidden camera and AI to get a near-perfect mark on the significant test.

items.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
items.description: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.

items.title: Israel kills Hamas commander in strike on Gaza camp, officials say
items.description: Both Hamas and IDF officials confirm the death of Samir Abu Younis, commander of the Rafah Brigade.

items.title: New Orleans port files $1m lawsuit over 'miracle on the Mississippi' tanker collision
items.description: The lawsuit filed by New Orleans officials also requests that the tanker involved in the collision with the cruise ship be seized and sold to pay for damages.

items.title: Fifth Canadian soldier dies from injuries caused by large fire at military base
items.description: Pte William Douglas Dal Bianco died from his injuries on Friday, a month after a fire that tore through CFB Wainwright.

items.title: Judge blocks Trump closure of 'Trash Island' Washington DC golf course on Sunday
items.description: The temporary order is part of a months-long challenge to the US president's plans to upgrade East Potomac Golf Links into a championship course.

items.title: Pope Leo speaks of community 'suffering' on visit to remote Andes town
items.description: Santa Cruz de Succhabamba is part of the Diocese of Chiclayo, where the Pope served as bishop from 2015 to 2023.

items.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
items.description: The US has not confirmed the Ukrainian president's comments - a US official told the BBC "many ideas continue to be discussed".

items.title: Philippines wins first Eurovision Song Contest Asia
items.description: Front-runner Carmelle emerges victorious with her women's empowerment anthem Sobra-Sobra.

items.title: Copper wire upgrade behind US flight suspension, transport secretary says
items.description: The US government is trying to find out whether the chaos was caused by "incompetence" or faulty equipment.

items.title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
items.description: The social media giant is accused of not informing 20 million users it had access to their photos.

items.title: Sotheby's auction of $180m Van Gogh challenged over claims it was 'sold under duress'
items.description: Sotheby's says it will work with the heirs of a family who had previously owned the artwork to try and reach a solution.

items.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
items.description: Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.

items.title: Hungarian authorities uncover $20m during probe of Orbán-era minister
items.description: Prime Minister Péter Magyar promised a sweeping anti-corruption drive after ousting Orbán in April.

items.title: Nigeria cautions against travel via Ethiopia's main airport due to altitude
items.description: The foreign ministry in Abuja says 6 Nigerians with underlying health problems have died this year while transiting through Addis Ababa.

items.title: 'Can you believe it?': SpaceX catches part of its Starship rocket on return to Earth
items.description: SpaceX has performed the historic catch using mechanical arms nicknamed "chopsticks".

items.title: Watch: Cruise ship overturns after collision with tanker in New Orleans
items.description: Around 130 people were rescued from a cruise ship after it was struck by a tanker while docked in New Orleans, Louisiana on Friday.

items.title: Watch: Divers explore US ship sunk off Florida coast to create new reef
items.description: The ship was intentionally sunk off the coast of Florida in order to create the world's largest artificial ocean reef.
